notes: Both cola write `קוֹל` as a bare adverbial accusative of instrument with no preposition or object marker on it, so each takes its own supplied *with*/*With* under rule 33, headed on the noun and discontinuous around the possessive under rule 25. This is not rule 25's distributed scope, since the Hebrew writes the noun twice and each occurrence has a rendering of its own.

`אֶתְחַנָּן` → *do I make supplication* is rule 44's light verb plus complement, headed on *supplication*, which carries the lexeme; *make* alone makes anything. No interrogative morpheme stands in the clause, so the fronted *do* is the finite verb's own emphatic auxiliary under rule 17 rather than rule 17's question auxiliary.
